extDescription.message: Tabverse is an opinionated way of managing tabs.

popupReplaceNewTitle.message: Start a new tabverse in this window?

popupReplaceNewBody.message: This window already has a tabverse ("$1"). It is saved automatically, so nothing is lost. Continuing closes it here and starts a new tabverse; the tabs in this window become part of it.

popupAddToWindowTitle.message: Add this tabverse to this window?

popupAddToWindowBody.message: This window already has a tabverse ("$1"). It is saved automatically, so nothing is lost. Continuing makes "$2" the tabverse of this window and opens its $3 tab(s) here: the tabs already open in this window stay, and the ones of that tabverse already open here are reused.

popupImportFailed.message: That file is not a Tabverse export.

popupNothingSaved.message: No tabverse saved yet. Every window you keep with Tabverse becomes one, and shows up here afterwards.

popupNothingFound.message: Nothing found. Try fewer words, or a word from a tab title.

popupNothingRecent.message: Nothing recent. Open a tabverse in a window and it shows up here.

popupGoToWindowOfTabverse.message: Go to the window of this tabverse

suspendOffSummary.message: Suspension is off. No tab is unloaded.

suspendOnSummary.message: Tabs left alone for more than $1 minutes are unloaded; opening one reloads it.

suspendHint.message: A suspended tab is unloaded from memory but stays in the tab strip. Opening it again reloads the page; nothing is closed. Tabverse only suspends tabs in a window that has a tabverse open, and never one you whitelist, pin, or are listening to.

appearanceHint.message: The rail carries near-white glyphs - the logo, the caption, the icons in the bar at the bottom - so the choices here are all dark. The colour belongs to the tabverse in this window: it follows the window, and it travels with the tabverse.

appearanceRandomLabel.message: Use a random colour for a new tabverse

appearanceRandomOn.message: A new tabverse rolls a colour from this palette.

appearanceRandomOff.message: A new tabverse starts with the default colour.

dedupOffSummary.message: The duplicate advisor is off. No tab is looked at.

dedupOnSummary.message: Open tabs are checked every $1 minutes; duplicates are offered for removal, never closed on their own.

dedupHint.message: The advisor only looks. When it finds two open tabs on the same page in a window with a tabverse, the tab list shows a notice where you can close the extras or ignore them. It never closes a tab by itself, and never touches a pinned tab or one that is playing audio.

aiCalloutHint.message: The features below run on the model Chrome ships with itself (Gemma Nano), on this device. What you point them at is handed to the model inside the browser and is never sent anywhere; no server, no account, nothing to configure.

aiFeatureNameTabverseWhere.message: Open a tabverse; the lightbulb is next to its name at the top, and it suggests three names to pick from.

aiFeatureSummarizeTabWhere.message: In an open tabverse, the lightbulb is on the right of every live tab row, and it turns that page into a new note.

aiDownloadTitle.message: Downloads once, on this device; the model is Chrome's own and is not shipped with the extension
